extracted.intended_audience: aspiring and practicing stand-up comedians and comedy writers (beginners through experienced)
extracted.subtask_description: A sales/how-to page for a comedy-writing system and ebook that teaches joke structures, psychological triggers, writer's‑block cures, and practice/accountability tools to help comedians write more and increase laughs per minute.

rubrics_metrics.name: The 13 Major Comedy Structures
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as core structural frameworks to construct jokes; page implies you should learn these structures and apply multiple structures to a topic to generate material.

rubrics_metrics.name: 9 Psychological Laughter Triggers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies psychological mechanisms that reliably produce laughter; presented as a set of triggers to invoke when crafting jokes.

rubrics_metrics.name: 12 Sure-Fire Ways to Beat Writer's Block
rubrics_metrics.description: 12 Sure-Fire Ways to Beat Writer's Block
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concrete techniques promised to overcome creative blocks; tied to the claim 'Make Writer's Block a Thing of the Past.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Writer's Accountability Calendar (BONUS)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A tool/bonus to structure, schedule, and hold oneself accountable to regular joke-writing practice to increase output.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to Increase Your Laughs by 400% (BONUS)
rubrics_metrics.description: How to Increase Your Laughs by 400%
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A bonus module/technique set claimed to dramatically boost laugh-rate; implies measurable goal of increasing laughs per minute.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pick a Topic and start writing jokes using multiple structures
rubrics_metrics.description: Pick a Topic and start writing jokes using multiple structures
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical instruction: select a single topic and generate jokes by applying several structural templates (ties back to the 13 structures). Encourages volume generation from one seed idea.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stop Guessing whether something is funny
rubrics_metrics.description: Stop Guessing whether something is funny.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advocates learning methods/criteria to evaluate funniness systematically rather than relying on guesswork or intuition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make Writer's Block a Thing of the Past
rubrics_metrics.description: Make Writer's Block a Thing of the Past
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promise that applying the book's processes and exercises will remove writer's block; related to the 12 sure‑fire ways and accountability tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Learn how to fix jokes that weren't working before
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn how to fix jokes that weren't working before
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides troubleshooting/editing strategies to revise weak or non-performing jokes into stronger bits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Learn to Write Volumes of jokes from a single topic
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn to Write Volumes of jokes from a single topic
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Teaches techniques for mining a single subject to produce many distinct jokes, increasing material output and options for sets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Learn the Secret to writing great roast jokes
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn the Secret to writing great roast jokes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Feature/lesson focused on structuring and crafting roast-style jokes; implies genre-specific rules and safety/technique considerations (no further detail on ethics provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: Increase your laughs per minute whether you're writing jokes or stories
rubrics_metrics.description: Increase your laughs per minute whether you're writing jokes or stories
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aimed at improving pace and density of humor across formats (short jokes and longer anecdotal stories) to maximize audience response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Master Your Joke Writing Today!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High‑level goal/promised outcome: attain mastery of joke writing through the system; functions as an overall performance objective for users of the material.
